347:t_1:87.en:
???
「...$$クロノ$$ exists in various parallel worlds and has controlled history from the shadows in the name of watching over humanity's evolution...」

347:t_1:88.en:
???
「But defectors calling themselves Reformists emerged from within $$クロノ$$.」

347:t_1:90.en:
???
「One of them, $$破嵐創造$$, created a new humanity, the $$メガノイド$$s, by strengthening human will, or ego, to artificially accelerate evolution.」

347:t_1:91.en:
???
「At the cost of his own wife and son.」

347:t_1:92.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I see. You're the one who disposed of them.」

347:t_1:93.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「As thanks for saving me the trouble, I'll deign to ask your name.」

347:t_1:95.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Oh... So you're the famous $$破嵐万丈$$.」

347:t_1:96.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$怨嗟の魔蠍$$, $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$... I've heard about you too.」

347:t_1:97.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「What does someone like you knowing about me matter?」

347:t_1:98.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$サイデリアル$$... I already know you're above $$クロノ$$.」

347:t_1:99.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「And what does it matter?」

347:t_1:100.en:
$$万丈$$
「I swear on this red earth. I will not permit your existence.」

347:t_2:3.en: ～$$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$　Hangar～

347:t_2:4.en:
$$クルツ$$
「...So you really were transported to the center of the galaxy!?」

347:t_2:5.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We were just as surprised.」

347:t_2:6.en:
$$甲児$$
「We split into two groups again in subspace, and wherever each group ended up, we fought $$バアル$$ over and over.」

347:t_2:7.en:
$$デュオ$$
「You mean $$宇宙怪獣$$ and $$インベーダー#robot$$s when you say $$バアル$$?」

347:t_2:8.en:
$$レド$$
「There were more. We also encountered $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$.」

347:t_2:9.en:
$$宗介$$
「We fought them too. They were formidable enemies, worthy of their battle against humanity for survival.」

347:t_2:10.en:
$$クルツ$$
「It sounds like your battles were every bit as tough as ours.」

347:t_2:11.en:
$$桂$$
「Well... It seems theirs were on a much bigger scale, though.」

347:t_2:12.en:
$$アルト$$
「Even so, we gained something from it too.」

347:t_2:13.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「The $$クォーター$$ met up with $$バトル７$$, and we investigated $$プロトカルチャー$$ ruins.」

347:t_2:15.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「It's the fleet $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$ and I belonged to. It seems $$バサラ$$'s songs drew us to them.」

347:t_2:16.en:
$$カトル$$
「I can't believe something like that could happen...」

347:t_2:17.en:
$$桂$$
「It isn't unthinkable. $$バサラ$$'s songs have crossed space and time and caused incredible phenomena before.」

347:t_2:18.en:
$$甲児$$
「Like the $$クォーター$$ rejoining the fleet through $$バサラ$$'s songs, $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ met up with the similarly transported $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$ through $$ゲッター線$$.」

347:t_2:19.en:
$$桂$$
「If $$ゲッター線$$ were involved, was $$竜馬$$ the key figure in that group...?」

347:t_2:20.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The $$クォーター$$ group, at the $$プロトカルチャー$$ ruins, and $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$, from Dr. $$早乙女#getter$$, whom $$ゲッター線$$ led them to again...」

347:t_2:21.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Learned about the collapse of the universe that comes once every 12,000 years.」

347:t_2:22.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Do you mean the clash between the force that seeks to vanish and the force that seeks to exist?」

347:t_2:24.en:
$$カトル$$
「That's the same as Dr. $$トライア$$'s research report.」

347:t_2:25.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Then there's no doubt that thing in $$リモネシア$$'s ruins was the real deal.」

347:t_2:26.en:
$$アルト$$
「We gained something else too. We learned the missing $$ブレラ$$ had been taken in by the $$マクロス７船団$$.」

347:t_2:28.en:
$$クルツ$$
(He's awfully unfriendly for the $$超時空シンデレラ$$'s big brother.)

347:t_2:29.en:
$$マオ$$
(But, well, he looks more like her than Major $$オズマ$$ does as her brother.)

347:t_2:30.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「$$ランカ$$'s brother is $$オズマ・リー$$. I merely share her blood.」

347:t_2:33.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「That's because I'm a cyborg who received $$インプラント$$ procedures in the $$ギャラクシー船団$$.」

347:t_2:34.en:
$$宗介$$
「The $$ギャラクシー船団$$... They tried to use $$バジュラ$$'s power in the $$再世戦争$$ and lost to $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$.」

347:t_2:35.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「My mind was controlled, and I fought as their soldier.」

347:t_2:36.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「But now I'm free of that, and I fight to protect $$ランカ$$.」

347:t_2:37.en:
$$桂$$
「All right, $$ブレラ$$. We'll be counting on you from now on.」

347:t_2:38.en:
$$アルト$$
「My $$ＹＦ－２９$$'s repairs are finished too, using $$バトル７$$'s materials. I think it'll add to our strength.」

347:t_2:39.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「$$ブレラ$$ wasn't our only unexpected reunion.」

347:t_2:40.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Let me introduce her. ...This is $$シビル$$. She's a support member of $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$.」

347:t_2:43.en:
$$桂$$
「A girl like this is very welcome.」

347:t_2:46.en:
$$桂$$
「W-we... haven't even tried to hit on you yet...」

347:t_2:47.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「$$シビル$$ is a 《$$プロトデビルン$$》.」

347:t_2:48.en:
$$桂$$
「Hold on! $$ガムリン$$ told me about $$プロトデビルン$$ before. Aren't they the enemies who fought the $$マクロス７船団$$?」

347:t_2:49.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「That's all in the past.」

347:t_2:50.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「After hearing $$バサラ$$'s songs, the $$プロトデビルン$$ learned to regenerate $$スピリチア$$ themselves, so they no longer need to attack other living beings.」

347:t_2:51.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「That means they are now no different from us.」

347:t_2:52.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「$$サイデリアル$$'s attack had put us in a crisis, but $$ゲペルニッチ$$, leader of the $$プロトデビルン$$, came to our aid...」

347:t_2:53.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「And $$シビル$$ joined us to support $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$.」

347:t_2:54.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「When $$バサラ$$ sings 'POWER TO THE DREAM', $$シビル$$ joins in too.」

347:t_2:56.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I get it this time. That's a cry of joy at meeting us, right?」

347:t_2:57.en:
$$桂$$
「I'm counting on you, $$シビル$$. When we have some time, I'll show you Earth's date spots.」

347:t_2:59.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$ブレラ$$ and $$シビル$$ weren't the only ones we met again.」

347:t_2:60.en:
$$正太郎$$
「The $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ group met $$グーラ$$ and $$ゼウス$$ at the galactic center.」

347:t_2:61.en:
$$デュオ$$
「By $$グーラ$$, do you mean the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s son?」

347:t_2:62.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Yes. He said he'd come to the galactic center to investigate $$ゲッター線$$ and $$バアル$$.」

347:t_2:63.en:
$$甲児$$
「The $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ isn't around to bind him anymore. He helped us fight $$バアル$$.」

347:t_2:64.en:
$$正太郎$$
「He left after the battle was over, though.」

347:t_2:66.en:
$$甲児$$
「We didn't just fight $$バアル$$ at the galactic center. During our battles with $$宇宙怪獣$$, we encountered $$ミケーネ神$$s again.」

347:t_2:67.en:
$$宗介$$
「Were they survivors of the ones we fought in the $$時獄戦役$$?」
